gemini.rationale: The slice indicates that the product/asset tier (branches) and the operational processes (systems) transferred together, so there is no gap_45. However, there is a gap_56 because the operational systems transferred but the organization/people tier crossed only selectively (all Park Sterling directors and executive officers ceased serving, with only a small subset re-engaged). There is no mention of a transitional-services agreement mitigating this gap at closing.

grok.rationale: gap_45=1 because the whole-company/bank merger at closing transferred Park Sterling’s branch-banking franchise (T4) into South State Bank while systems conversion—the operational/process alignment—was expressly scheduled to complete only after legal closing, not at it (DEFM14A conversion-payment and integration-risk disclosures; structural summary). gap_56=1 because that post-close process/systems re-engineering was structured alongside a selective people transfer: all Park Sterling directors and executive officers ceased at the effective time, with only a named subset re-engaged under new consulting/employment agreements and two board appointments, while South State’s pre-closing officers continued (8-K; DEFM14A). No transitional-services or operating agreement allocating a shared substrate is documented—only individual executive arrangements—so gap_mitigated=no.

openai.rationale: Park Sterling’s whole branch-banking franchise and bank subsidiary crossed into South State at closing, but systems conversion was expressly scheduled for completion after legal closing, documenting a product-versus-process mismatch at that time. [SRC: SEC accession 0001047469-17-005768, Form DEFM14A] The organization tier also transferred only selectively: all Park Sterling directors and executive officers ceased serving, while only a small subset received new consulting, employment, or board roles, alongside disclosed workforce-integration risk. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-17-071280, Form 8-K] [SRC: SEC accession 0001047469-17-005768, Form DEFM14A] No transitional-services or operating agreement allocating the shared operational substrate at closing is documented in the slice.
